shown_card_text.title: Index cards shuffle and land in order
shown_card_text.what: Your index labels (Episodes, Shorts, Thumbnails and more) lift, tumble through the air and land back in a row with blue dots lighting. Mid-flight the cards turn into dark tiles with odd markings, so the middle second looks messy.
shown_card_text.why: You asked for more reusable Higgsfield shots, and each one needs your verdict.
shown_card_text.question: What should happen to this shot?
shown_card_text.recommendation: Probably an edit: keep the start and the landing, cut the messy tumble.
context: Made with your ten dollar top up, inside your thirty dollar month.
Generated sound is dropped; episodes keep our own music.

visual_input_policy: The exact first existing still/poster shown on the source card. It is one frame, not full video or audio.
